_meta.description: Failure-mode taxonomy derived from external helpdesk dataset patterns and CallCallum assessment experience

failure_modes.label: Missing affected user
failure_modes.definition: Ticket does not identify which user(s) are affected by the issue.
failure_modes.operational_consequence: Second line cannot verify user identity or contact them for follow-up.
evidence_patterns: Ticket says "user" or "customer" without name
No user ID or email in ticket
Candidate did not ask caller name during call
failure_modes.coaching_action: Train first-line to always capture the affected user name, email, and contact method at the start of every interaction.

failure_modes.label: Missing affected device
failure_modes.definition: Ticket does not specify which device, system, or application is affected.
failure_modes.operational_consequence: Technician must contact user to determine device details before starting work.
evidence_patterns: Ticket says "computer" or "laptop" without hostname or model
No IP address or asset tag recorded
No application name or version specified
failure_modes.coaching_action: Train first-line to capture device hostname, OS, IP address, and application version when applicable.

failure_modes.label: Missing affected scope
failure_modes.definition: Ticket does not state whether the issue affects one user, multiple users, one device, one site, or a wider service.
failure_modes.operational_consequence: Second line may repeat discovery questions or misprioritise the issue.
evidence_patterns: Ticket describes issue without stating scope
No indication of single-user vs. widespread
No site or location information
failure_modes.coaching_action: Train first-line to document affected user(s), device(s), service, and business impact.

failure_modes.label: Missing business impact
failure_modes.definition: Ticket does not describe what the user cannot do as a result of the issue.
failure_modes.operational_consequence: Priority may be mis-set and second line lacks context for urgency.
evidence_patterns: Ticket says "not working" without impact description
No mention of deadline, client, or revenue impact
No documentation of blocked tasks
failure_modes.coaching_action: Train first-line to ask "What are you unable to do because of this?" and document the answer in the ticket.

failure_modes.label: Missing error message or status
failure_modes.definition: Ticket does not record any error message, error code, or system status.
failure_modes.operational_consequence: Second line lacks diagnostic starting point.
evidence_patterns: Ticket says "error" without the actual message
No error code captured
No screenshot or exact wording of error
failure_modes.coaching_action: Train first-line to always capture the exact error message, code, or system status before escalating.

failure_modes.label: Missing troubleshooting steps attempted
failure_modes.definition: Ticket does not document what troubleshooting was already attempted by the user or first-line.
failure_modes.operational_consequence: Second line may repeat already-done steps, wasting time.
evidence_patterns: Ticket says "troubleshot" without specifics
No list of steps already tried
No documentation of results of attempted fixes
failure_modes.coaching_action: Train first-line to document every troubleshooting step attempted and its result, even if unsuccessful.

failure_modes.label: Missing escalation reason
failure_modes.definition: Escalated ticket does not explain why first-line cannot resolve.
failure_modes.operational_consequence: Second line lacks context and may reject or delay escalation.
evidence_patterns: Ticket says "escalating" without reason
No indication of what was attempted before escalation
No specific request for second-line action
failure_modes.coaching_action: Train first-line to always include specific reason for escalation, what was tried, and what second-line action is needed.

failure_modes.label: Unclear resolution
failure_modes.definition: Ticket does not clearly describe what was done to resolve the issue.
failure_modes.operational_consequence: Knowledge base cannot be built from resolved tickets; issue may recur without known fix.
evidence_patterns: Ticket says "fixed" or "resolved" without details
No root cause documented
No resolution steps recorded
failure_modes.coaching_action: Train first-line to document the root cause and exact resolution steps before closing a ticket.

failure_modes.label: Poor closure confirmation
failure_modes.definition: Ticket is closed without confirming with the user that the issue is resolved.
failure_modes.operational_consequence: User may still be affected, leading to re-opened tickets and poor satisfaction.
evidence_patterns: No customer confirmation before closure
Ticket closed based on technical fix alone
No follow-up message to user
failure_modes.coaching_action: Train first-line to always confirm resolution with the user before closing a ticket.

failure_modes.label: Multi-assignee handoff without context
failure_modes.definition: Ticket is reassigned multiple times without carrying context forward.
failure_modes.operational_consequence: Each new assignee must re-do discovery, causing user frustration.
evidence_patterns: Multiple assignee changes in history
No handover notes between assignees
Context lost with each reassignment
failure_modes.coaching_action: Train first-line to write clear handover notes when reassigning, including what has been done and what remains.

failure_modes.label: Long time in unresolved state
failure_modes.definition: Ticket remains in open/unresolved state for extended period without update.
failure_modes.operational_consequence: User perceives neglect; SLA likely breached.
evidence_patterns: Ticket open for days without assignee action
No status updates during long resolution
Gaps between status changes exceed SLA thresholds
failure_modes.coaching_action: Train first-line to provide regular status updates on long-running tickets, even if no resolution is ready.

failure_modes.label: Priority/category mismatch
failure_modes.definition: Assigned priority or category does not match the described severity or issue type.
failure_modes.operational_consequence: Ticket may be routed incorrectly or receive insufficient attention.
evidence_patterns: High-impact issue assigned low priority
Category does not match described symptoms
Priority set before scope/impact determined
failure_modes.coaching_action: Train first-line to set priority and category based on documented impact and scope, not assumption.

failure_modes.label: Vague customer update
failure_modes.definition: Update to customer is vague and does not communicate status, timeline, or next steps.
failure_modes.operational_consequence: Customer remains uncertain and may escalate unnecessarily.
evidence_patterns: Update says "working on it" without specifics
No ETA or timeline provided
No explanation of current status
failure_modes.coaching_action: Train first-line to provide structured updates: what is being done, what is the ETA, what the customer should expect next.
